capabilities: Save named snapshots of the current note and its embedded attachments
Diff snapshots against the current note or the previous snapshot
Restore snapshots without creating new ones, including recovering missing or changed attachments
Manually clean up orphaned histories of deleted notes
disambiguation: Not whole-vault commit-style history; it snapshots one note and its embedded attachments at a time and points users to obsidian-git for coarse-grained history.
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Snapshots are plain files stored in the vault (default .note-snapshots folder) so they sync with existing vault sync tools; note identity relies on an ns-id frontmatter key that must be preserved.
motivation: The author wrote it to solve their own problems; the README states no feature changes are planned, only bug and compatibility fixes.
problem: Obsidian has no per-note, manual version history: file recovery is automatic and vault-wide, and git plugins work at whole-vault granularity rather than per note.

relations.evidence: If you need whole-vault, commit-style history across many files at once, use obsidian-git instead

summary: Per-note version-control plugin that saves named snapshots of a note and its embedded attachments, with diffs, locking, and restore.
